OUOOO organizes those details so buyers can compare properly — and know exactly what must be verified in a quotation, an approved sample, or a written specification before committing.

entries.source: Brazil has roughly 120 million Catholics, the largest Catholic population of any country, and the rosary is an everyday devotional object rather than an occasional gift. A supplier who plans only for “Brazil” will overstock the wrong item; a supplier who plans for Aparecida, Fatima, Carmo and the sacramental seasons will not.

entries.source: Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal

Nobody told Miss Sang to make a rosary. In 2015, she was a young woman living in Yiwu — a city that supplies the world's shelves, yet rarely pauses to ask what the things it makes might mean. She had been drawn to religious objects for years: their weight, their quiet symbolism, the way skilled hands could turn simple materials into something a stranger would hold during the hardest moments of their life.
entries.translation: Nihče ni rekel gospodični Sang, naj naredi rožni venec. Leta 2015 je bila mlada ženska, ki je živela v Yiwuju — mestu, ki oskrbuje police sveta, a le redko ustavi, da bi vprašalo, kaj bi stvari, ki jih izdeluje, lahko pomenile. Že leta so jo privlačili verski predmeti: njihova teža, njihova tiha simbolika, način, kako lahko spretne roke spremenijo preproste materiale v nekaj, kar bo neznanec držal v najtežjih trenutkih svojega življenja.

entries.source: Stainless steel is used for chain, pins, jump rings, crosses, medals, and laser-cut components where durability and corrosion resistance are priorities. Stainless steel is a family of grades, not one material. Grade 304 is widely used; grade 316 contains molybdenum and generally offers stronger resistance in chloride-rich environments. Lower-cost grades may behave differently. Ask for the grade and confirm whether every component is stainless steel or only the main visible part.

entries.source: Each decade is one Our Father, ten Hail Marys and one Glory Be while meditating a single mystery. The Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious and Luminous mysteries each contain exactly five decades, so a 5-decade rosary completes one full set in a single piece.

entries.source: Zinc alloy is common for cast crucifixes, medals, centerpieces, and decorative charms because it can reproduce complex shapes and accept many surface finishes. The visible antique silver, gold, bronze, or black appearance is usually a finish — not proof of the base metal. Confirm alloy requirements, plating system, topcoat, wear expectations, and limits for lead, cadmium, nickel release, or other restricted substances required by the destination market.
entries.translation: Cinkova zlitina je običajna za lite križe, medalje, sredinske kose in okrasne obeske, ker lahko reproducira zapletene oblike in sprejme številne površinske obdelave. Vidni videz starega srebra, zlata, brona ali črne barve je običajno obdelava – ne dokaz osnovne kovine. Potrdite zahteve glede zlitine, sistem prevleke, zaključni premaz, pričakovano obrabo in omejitve glede svinca, kadmija, sproščanja niklja ali drugih omejenih snovi, ki jih zahteva ciljni trg.

entries.source: Brazilian rosary demand spans a very wide price range, from low-cost rosaries bought by the hundred for parish distribution to gift pieces sold individually in a box. The segments are not interchangeable: a buyer sourcing for bulk distribution is not comparing the same product as a gift shop, and a quote that is competitive in one segment can be uncompetitive in the other.
entries.translation: Povpraševanje po rožnih vencih v Braziliji zajema zelo širok cenovni razpon, od poceni rožnih vencev, kupljenih na stotine za župnijsko razdeljevanje, do darilnih kosov, ki se prodajajo posamično v škatli. Segmenti niso medsebojno zamenljivi: kupec, ki nabavlja za množično razdeljevanje, ne primerja istega izdelka kot darilna trgovina, in ponudba, ki je konkurenčna v enem segmentu, je lahko v drugem nekonkurenčna.

entries.source: A Brazilian rosary programme works best when the segment is chosen first: bulk distribution, mainstream retail, gift or private label. That decision fixes the price band, the packaging and the quality level, and it makes the devotional and language requirements much easier to confirm. Approve a sample against that specification before production, and keep it for the next season.
entries.translation: Brazilska programska shema rožnega venca deluje najbolje, če najprej izberete segment: množična distribucija, splošna maloprodaja, darilo ali zasebna blagovna znamka. Ta odločitev določi cenovni razred, embalažo in raven kakovosti ter močno olajša potrjevanje zahtev glede pobožnosti in jezika. Odobrite vzorec v skladu s to specifikacijo pred proizvodnjo in ga shranite za naslednjo sezono.

entries.source: The middle of the market. Buyers want a recognisable style, a presentable pack and a price that works on a shelf. Wood, glass and coloured beads are common, and packaging starts to matter as much as the rosary itself.
entries.translation: Srednji del trga. Kupci želijo prepoznaven slog, primerno embalažo in ceno, ki deluje na polici. Les, steklo in barvne kroglice so pogosti, embalaža pa postaja enako pomembna kot sam rožni venec.

entries.source: In-stock catalogue items are the fastest route: most styles are held in quantity, can be mixed in one shipment, and are typically dispatched within about ten days of order confirmation. If the programme needs a specific colour, a parish name, a custom card or a different pendant, that is a production decision rather than a stock decision, and it needs a sample and a written specification before bulk work begins.

Če program zahteva določeno barvo, ime župnije, kartico po meri ali drugačen obesek, je to proizvodna odločitev in ne odločitev o zalogi, zato je pred začetkom serijske proizvodnje potreben vzorec in pisna specifikacija.

entries.source: The practical implication is to define the target unit price before choosing the product. Bead material, bead size, the crucifix and centerpiece, the cord or chain, and the packaging all move the cost, and the packaging is often the easiest place to protect a price point. A simple bag can keep a retail-ready rosary inside a lower band; a printed box can push the same rosary into a gift band.
entries.translation: Praktična posledica je, da ciljno ceno na enoto določite pred izbiro izdelka. entries.source: Offer at least two price bands.

A cross is a shape. It can be plain, engraved, jewelled or decorative, and it does not by itself tell you whether a corpus is present. A crucifix is a cross that bears the corpus, the figure of Christ. Catholics commonly use a crucifix for personal devotion and on a rosary, and many Catholic buyers will notice immediately if a listing calls a crucifix a cross or the other way around.
entries.translation: Križ je oblika. Lahko je preprost, graviran, okrašen z dragulji ali okrasen in sam po sebi ne pove, ali je na njem korpus. Razpelo je križ, ki nosi korpus, lik Kristusa. Katoličani običajno uporabljajo razpelo za osebno pobožnost in na rožnem vencu, in mnogi katoliški kupci bodo takoj opazili, če je v oglasu razpelo označeno kot križ ali obratno.

entries.source: Packaging is not decoration added at the end of an order. It decides how the product is protected in transit, how it is counted and distributed, whether it can carry a barcode, and whether a buyer sees a bulk item or a gift. For wholesale buyers, the packaging choice usually has a larger effect on perceived value than a small change in bead cost.

Odloča o tem, kako je izdelek zaščiten med prevozom, kako se šteje in razdeljuje, ali lahko nosi črtno kodo in ali kupec vidi razsuti artikel ali darilo. Pri veleprodajnih kupcih ima izbira embalaže običajno večji vpliv na zaznano vrednost kot majhna sprememba stroškov kroglic.

Če je odgovor razpon, vprašajte, kaj ga spreminja: količina, število barv, material ali število SKU-jev, ki si delijo eno zasnovo.

entries.source: When the Luminous mysteries were added in 2002, the Church did not change the physical rosary. Believers continue to use the 5-decade rosary and simply choose one set of five mysteries to meditate each day.

entries.source: In religious goods, the words carry meaning. A buyer looking for a crucifix for a rosary is not looking for a plain cross. A parish ordering scapulars is not ordering medals. Getting the term right protects the customer, avoids returns, and signals that the supplier understands the products rather than treating them as generic jewellery.
entries.translation: V verskem blagu imajo besede pomen. Kupec, ki išče razpelo za rožni venec, ne išče preprostega križa. Župnija, ki naroča škapulirje, ne naroča medaljonov. Pravilen izraz zaščiti kupca, prepreči vračila in kaže, da dobavitelj izdelke razume, namesto da bi jih obravnaval kot splošni nakit.

entries.source: A rosary always has the same number of beads, so bead size controls weight, volume and how comfortably it can be held. For children receiving a First Communion rosary, a smaller, lighter bead is easier to hold through a service and less likely to be dropped or tangled. For Confirmation candidates and adult congregations, an adult-size rosary is the safer default.
entries.translation: Rožni venec ima vedno enako število kroglic, zato velikost kroglic določa težo, prostornino in udobje pri držanju. Za otroke, ki prejmejo rožni venec ob prvem svetem obhajilu, je manjša in lažja kroglica lažja za držanje med obredom in manj verjetno jo bodo spustili ali zapletli. Za kandidate za sveto birmo in odrasle skupnosti je rožni venec velikosti za odrasle varnejša izbira.

entries.source: A rosary that falls apart in a month disrespects the buyer and the person who made it. Every product passes multi-stage inspection across material sourcing, production, and packaging.
entries.translation: Rožni venec, ki se v mesecu dni razpade, je nespoštljiv do kupca in do osebe, ki ga je izdelala. Vsak izdelek prestane večstopenjski pregled pri nabavi materiala, proizvodnji in embalaži.

entries.source: Durability also depends on how the rosary is assembled. Nylon and polyester cord can provide strength and consistent color; cotton feels natural but can absorb moisture; waxed cord changes feel and knot behavior; elastic is convenient for bracelets but requires stretch-life testing. Metal-linked rosaries depend on wire gauge, eye-pin closure, jump-ring construction, chain material, and plating quality. Ask for pull testing or repeat-use testing when the application demands it.
entries.translation: Vzdržljivost je odvisna tudi od tega, kako je rožni venec sestavljen. Najlonska in poliestrska vrvica lahko zagotovita trdnost in enakomerno barvo; bombaž je naraven, vendar lahko absorbira vlago; voskana vrvica spremeni občutek in obnašanje vozlov; elastika je priročna za zapestnice, vendar zahteva testiranje vzdržljivosti raztezanja. Rožni venci s kovinskimi členi so odvisni od debeline žice, zapiranja zatičev z očesom, konstrukcije obročkov, materiala verige in kakovosti prevleke. Zahtevajte testiranje natezne trdnosti ali testiranje ponavljajoče se uporabe, kadar aplikacija to zahteva.

Requirements can differ for adult jewelry, children’s products, devotional objects, promotional gifts, and items sold in different countries. Children’s jewelry can involve specific controls for lead, cadmium, nickel, magnets, small parts, coatings, and other hazards. Tell us the destination market and intended user at the inquiry stage. The buyer remains responsible for identifying the standards and documentation required for its market, while OUOOO can help communicate those requirements to the relevant supply partners.

entries.source: Marian designs are judged on details: the colour of the mantle, the presence of a crown, the grotto, the image on the reverse, the spelling of the title. Ask the customer to approve a physical sample or a high-resolution proof before bulk production, and keep that approval with the written specification. It is the simplest way to avoid a devotional product that looks right in general but wrong to the people who know the devotion.

entries.source: The more detail, the more accurate the quote

Buyers often use “Our Lady of…” as if every devotion worked the same way. In practice, some titles come from reported apparitions, some from a venerated statue or icon, some from a religious order or a feast, and some from a sacramental such as the Brown Scapular. Knowing which is which prevents inaccurate product descriptions and avoids promising a meaning the object does not carry.
entries.translation: Kupci pogosto uporabljajo »Naša Gospa od …«, kot da bi vsaka pobožnost delovala na enak način. V praksi nekateri nazivi izhajajo iz poročanih prikazovanj, nekateri iz čaščene statue ali ikone, nekateri iz redovne skupnosti ali praznika, nekateri pa iz zakramentala, kot je rjavi škapulir. entries.source: These names describe different material families and should not be treated as interchangeable. Acrylic and other molded plastics are useful for lightweight, colorful, price-sensitive programs. Resin can support embedded images, handcrafted effects, and complex shapes. Soft PVC and silicone are used for flexible charms and children-oriented designs. Confirm the exact polymer, hardness, odor, colorfastness, molding marks, and destination-market requirements.
entries.translation: Ta imena opisujejo različne družine materialov in jih ne smemo obravnavati kot zamenljive. Akril in druge oblikovane plastike so uporabne za lahke, barvite in cenovno občutljive programe. Smola lahko podpira vdelane slike, ročno izdelane učinke in kompleksne oblike. Mehki PVC in silikon se uporabljata za prilagodljive šarme in dizajne za otroke. Potrdite natančen polimer, trdoto, vonj, obstojnost barv, sledi oblikovanja in zahteve ciljnega trga.

entries.source: On a rosary programme, the packaging is usually the easiest part to brand. Typical options include a printed logo on a pouch or box, a branded insert card, a hangtag, a barcode label, and private-label information that replaces the supplier name. The product itself can also be customized through bead material, colour, size, pendant style and centerpiece, but those changes affect tooling and minimum quantities far more than a printed card does.

Tipične možnosti vključujejo natisnjen logotip na vrečki ali škatli, vstavljeno kartico z blagovno znamko, visečo etiketo, nalepko s črtno kodo in informacije o lastni blagovni znamki, ki nadomestijo ime dobavitelja.
